name: Cohere
tagline: Command, Embed, Rerank, and enterprise retrieval APIs.
shortDescription: Cohere provides chat, embeddings, reranking, classification, and tool-use oriented APIs.
agentSummary: Good for agents that need strong RAG primitives like embeddings and reranking with clear API references.
bestFor: Embeddings, reranking, enterprise search, and retrieval-augmented generation.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: RAG agents should monitor source grounding, latency, and per-model pricing. Model behavior, costs, rate limits, data retention, and safety policies can change by model and account tier; use evals, spend caps, and data controls for sensitive workloads. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Store credentials outside source control and use least-privilege scopes, short-lived tokens, or restricted keys where the product supports them.
pricingSummary: Public model pricing and trial information.
browserSupport: Dashboard supports keys, playground, and usage checks.

capabilities.detail: Reference docs cover chat, embed, rerank, classify, and datasets.
Docs are structured around common RAG and model workflows.
Pricing is public by model family and operation.
Dashboard supports keys, playground, and usage checks.
